subject: Constrain variances/covariances between groups to be equal

messages.author: ea5016c05fb289b3
messages.subject: Constrain variances/covariances between groups to be equal
parts:
I want to test whether the variances/covariances of variables x, m, and y between five groups are invariant. I estimated the variances/covariances of the three variables for each group. All groups have a sample size of 100. I setup a multigroup model by inputting each variance/covariance matrix using sample.cov. Is there a way for me to constrain the variances/covariance to determine if they are invariant across the groups like how loadings are constrained using group.equal = "loadings"?

Thanks very much. 

model <- "x ~~ x
          m ~~ m
          y ~~ y
          x ~~ m
          m ~~ y
          y ~~ x"

fit <- sem(model,
           sample.cov=list(Group_01 = k_01,
                           Group_02 = k_02,
                           Group_03 = k_03,
                           Group_04 = k_04,
                           Group_05 = k_05),
           sample.nobs=100,
           meanstructure=FALSE)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Constrain variances/covariances between groups to be equal
parts: Is there a way for me to constrain the variances/covariance to determine if they are invariant across the groups like how loadings are constrained using group.equal = "loadings"?

Although the observed variables are not endogenous in this model, the keyword "residuals" on the ?sem help page is meant to refer to observed variables, as opposed to latent variables ("lv").  So group.equal = c("residuals","residual.covariances") should work.
